title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF continued to invest in the designing and tailoring to prevent and respond to violence, abuse against children, address social norms and harmful practices such as child marriage. As a result, 163,279 parents and caregivers, and 87,851 children in the targeted regions received child protection services.
